name: Clay
one_liner: Clay is a GTM platform for enriching and searching company and people data, with CLI, public API and agent access.
auth_notes: Clay API key in the clay-api-key header, tied to a user and workspace; created under API and CLI in the app or via clay api-keys create. Rate-limit docs also mention OAuth credentials.
access_notes: Pricing page lists Clay API access under the Enterprise plan (custom pricing, annual commitment); Growth lists HTTP API integrations (outbound) and webhooks. Developer docs do not state a plan gate; key creation is self-serve in the app. Gating of the Public API is ambiguous.

buildability.rationale: Documented Public API with self-serve key header and 300 req/min, but pricing page ties Clay API access to Enterprise; endpoint set is narrow (about 18 reference pages, tables marked Enterprise). Verify plan gate before building.

needs_human_reason: Pricing page says Enterprise includes Clay API access, but developer docs do not state a plan requirement; confirm whether lower plans can create public API keys. MCP server URL not found.

identity.quote: Data Credits are used when you purchase data from Clay's marketplace

auth.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the `clay-api-key` header.

access.quote: plus unlimited Audiences across sources, unlimited row bulk enrichment, Clay API access, data warehouse syncs, SSO

api_surface.quote: The default limit is **300 requests per minute per workspace**
Webhooks let Clay notify your service when a routine run finishes, so you can react without polling.

mcp.quote: Use MCP to call Clay functions from a coding agent like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.

disputes.why: Pricing page lists Clay API access under Enterprise plan with custom pricing.
Documented API with self-serve key header; plan gating and narrow surface are caveats.
API access appears on Enterprise tier, not just Growth.
Docs show curl to api.clay.com/public/v0 REST endpoints.
